questions.question: Slingerang: "If your opponent plays a character, you may remove a token from this card." The condition names "your opponent", but MP 2 selects the opponent per block and triggers choose when they resolve, which is after the event. Which opponent's play triggers it?
readings: (A) Any opponent's play triggers it; the player who played is the selected opponent for the block (a condition naming your opponent is met by selecting the player who did it).
(B) The opponent is selected once when Slingerang enters play (lasting text, RQ-mp-5); only that opponent's plays trigger it.
questions.recommendation: (A): it is the README rule for conditions ("satisfied by choosing" the player who meets it) and avoids tying a reactive trigger to one fixed opponent.

questions.question: Adroit Marauder: "While your opponent has at least 10 cards in their discard pile, this card gains 3 strength and 3 life." RQ-mp-5 selects the opponent when the lasting text "starts applying", but this text applies only while its condition holds. When is the opponent selected?

questions.recommendation: (A): it follows RQ-mp-5 literally (text that is on the table has a selected opponent) and is the only reading with a fixed choice; note that P3 reaching 10 cards does nothing while P2 is selected.
